groups.contract: City GPU address arithmetic and atomic compaction depend on one coherent CPU-prepared allocation
groups.disposition: Five complete exact shaders personally read; no shader validation, compile, dispatch, device or visual execution. select_buildings guards invocation x against count before building read; selection offset=view_index*building_count+id and visible output=view_draw*capacity+atomic reservation+cluster have no local overflow/storage-cap checks. compact_ranges folds2D launch index id.y*groups.x*64+id.x then guards source length, loops placement until job.x+count and incrementsu32; canonical CPU work/grid/range owner must prove these products/sums/reservations and packed fields fit actual arrays. Vertex divides/modulos by range.instances.y then uses cluster/owner/index/3stride and packed component transform. Zero cluster count, raw addition overflow or mismatched buffers would violate this contract, but no actual CPU-admitted bad range or GPU witness established. Do not count shader raw arithmetic alone as new ordinary defect. View selection history has explicit projection-w applicability and owner-level2 exclusion; camera/shadow histories and enclosure/overlay policy remain distinct. Existing coordinator connected GPU claims are dependencies, no coverage transfer.

groups.contract: City geometric transforms and fragment normal assumptions require actual prepared frames
groups.disposition: World/normal transforms multiply city-frame with building/component transform before normalization; tangent uses world transform and handedness. Correct normals under any supported nonuniform instance transform require actual CPU frame/transform admission; no such admitted disagreement demonstrated here. Fade smoothstep thresholds arrive by bitcast packed levels and must be ordered/finite at actual producer; this shader does not admit them. Early vertex local-index guard returns offscreen position and default other fields deliberately. Native mesh/normal sampling keeps actual packed3vec4layout and shader flagbit meanings, not an opportunity for a second semantic owner.

groups.contract: Ground shading arithmetic is bounded local work with explicit derivative/scale preconditions
groups.disposition: Fieldstones evaluates exactly3x3neighbor sites, fixed hash/noise and min distances; no city-wide scan or unbounded loop. Positive derivative determinant floor1e-6 prevents exact division byzero locally but cannot establish finite position/derivative or nonzero normalized normal. stone_uv divides world by ground.surface.y, and traffic transform/footprint/weather inputs require canonical material admission. Shader nonnegative square roots/max and narrow clamps preserve ordinary shading policy for valid finite inputs; texture samples/channel ranges and derivative execution are native GPU contracts, not source-proven images. No actual zero stone scale, bad producer uniform or visual artifact promoted.

groups.contract: Cloud optical interpolation and spherical wind compensation preserve actual input applicability
groups.disposition: Composite divides pixel coordinate by native viewport size; actual active render target must provide nonzero supported extent. Cloud roots compute discriminant then rejectnegative before sqrt, but squared finite extremes can overflow; actual admitted shell radius/eye/wind bounds and nonzero normalize directions remain producer dependencies, not a current huge-sphere defect. Wind compensated sampling normalizes endpoint directions, clamps blend0..1 and elevationasin0..1. Optical logs floor transmission1e-4, interpolate depth then exp, preserving explicit exponential response rather than raw alpha lerp. Premultiplied color/opacity output and fragment horizon/opacity discard remain intentional. Cached bakes, paired timestamps/wind/material values, texture identity and producer lifetime must form coherent aggregate; no transitive acceptance from shader reading or unrelated root codec proof.
